name: Dornen Orreth
keeps: what grows on her side of the wall
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: Assembled the largest library in England and advised on navigation for the northern voyages.
text: Dornen orreth of the open ledger, keeps a door for the 6th tranche, doors 48 to 57. Keeps what grows on her side of the wall. Reads John Dee.
